source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The cleanup removes the two locale popups and their helpers, while plain event/task buttons still call extractFromEmail with gMessage. The removed locale helper supplied null, but extractFromEmail immediately reads message.folder and its decoded subject. That is a static caller-contract mismatch in the removed path. The surviving extractor still accepts fixed-language parameters; this patch does not remove the whole extraction service or establish a rendered menu result.
title: Removing the extraction locale menu leaves message extraction commands intact
